title: prunus domestica subsp. cerea
intro: Prunus domestica subsp. cerea, commonly known as wild cherry, is a subspecies of the domestic plum tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Prunus domestica subsp. cerea include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate headaches, fever, and arthritis symptoms. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, contribute to its medicinal properties, providing antioxidant and antitumor activities.
